INSERT INTO jutsu_episode ( title_slug, season, episode, embed_url, video_qualities, last_synced_at ) VALUES
(#{ep.titleSlug}, #{ep.season}, #{ep.episode}, #{ep.embedUrl}, #{ep.videoQualities}, #{ep.lastSyncedAt})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE embed_url = COALESCE(VALUES(embed_url), embed_url), video_qualities = COALESCE(VALUES(video_qualities), video_qualities), last_synced_at = COALESCE(VALUES(last_synced_at), last_synced_at)
